title: Breakthru
description:
Accused of espionage against their own country, the pure and noble sisters Silas and Leila Nanashiel find themselves imprisoned without a fair trial. 

Leila gets sentenced to death for the alleged crime, her execution set to be carried out within merely a month. 

Only her sister Silas can save her from this fate, by breaking Leila out of prison. However, in order to gather information for their escape, Silas is forced to make deals with other prisoners and obey the guards’ harsh rule. 

Though no matter what happens, she won’t give up. With the help of other inmates, the two sisters will reunite in freedom. 

• Play as Silas, beautiful daughter of an aristocratic family imprisoned in the lawless ‘Otar Prison’. 

• Obtain information inside the prison and gather the seven jailbreakers to plot the breakout. 

• Live2d animations

• Dynamic expressions: Based on mood and story progression, Silas and the other girls showcase a broad array of emotions.

• A long story spanning across several chapters as you meet more characters and progress the escape plan.

• 100 save slots!

• A detailed minimap and fast travel feature for ease of navigation.
description_short: Imprisoned without a fair trial, it is up to Silas Nanashiel to escape together with the help of other inmates and save her elder sister Leila from receiving a fatal punishment.
